import_boundary_expectations: domain layer must not import application, infrastructure, interface, observability, or security adapters
application layer may depend on domain and application ports
infrastructure layer implements ports and owns persistence, outbox, idempotency, and migrations
interfaces layer calls application services and does not contain domain policy decisions
tests verify boundary behavior without weakening production code
state_machine_expectations: transitions are explicit and guard checked
invalid transitions fail closed with typed domain exceptions
idempotent replay avoids duplicate side effects
state transitions emit audit-safe domain events
